rules: Score evidence in the job description, not keyword frequency alone.
Do not infer visa sponsorship, salary, language level, or remote eligibility when not stated; mark unknown.
Penalize mandatory German fluency when the candidate profile does not support it.
Distinguish required skills from nice-to-have skills.
Explain every score with supporting JD evidence and candidate experience evidence.
A score is decision support, not a probability of getting an interview.
